intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间08:07–08:12实际尝试了全部12路信源。HF今日榜尚未开放；已读取11/10完整榜37篇，并复抓11/09的34篇，补查其中3个晚到成员。全来源去重新发现64项（57篇论文、7篇官方文章），完成来源与范围交叉审查：7项支持限定Harness范围、54项排除、3项待补。通过项包括SciMARS、JoMoHa、MIRIX、RoboScript、BadEvolve、TRUST、SkillCache，均按真实来源日期列为历史补录，不冒充今天新论文。RoboScript只收录经执行验证的工具技能构建分支；REINS更新领域规则记忆、ReSkill产出独立机器人程序、SMO缺执行反馈回流，均不计入Harness。Sage-Taiyi与Auriga仍缺自动修改和跨轮采用的具体证据；Materials world models正文受阻。三路arXiv查询成功，窗口内为0；五路RSS返回52条窗口记录；GitHub检查13个仓库，窗口内release为0。S2引文获取314条窗口记录、283个去重ID，但匿名限流和采集时间窗使部分内容未取得，作者来源也受429限制；未取得部分仍为未知。8项历史正文阻塞重试后未恢复。SMO官方摘要与正文存在倍数/百分比口径冲突，保留原文并记录疑点。新增付费生成请求为0。本期是采集时点的审核状态简报，不是新增论文日报，也不代表全天没有更新。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:07–08:12 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready. The complete Nov 10 board contained 37 papers; the refreshed Nov 9 board contained 34, including three late additions. Across sources, 64 new stable identities (57 papers and seven official articles) received source and scope cross-review: seven support narrowly defined Harness scope, 54 are excluded, and three need more evidence. SciMARS, JoMoHa, MIRIX, RoboScript, BadEvolve, TRUST and SkillCache retain their actual older source dates as historical backlog, not new papers today. RoboScript qualifies only for its execution-validated tool-skill construction branch. REINS updates domain-rule memory, ReSkill produces an independent robot program, and SMO explicitly lacks execution feedback into its basis; these are not counted as Harness evolution. Sage-Taiyi and Auriga still need concrete evidence of automatic artifact revision and adoption across rounds; the Materials world models publisher body remains inaccessible. Three arXiv searches succeeded with no window records, five RSS feeds returned 52 window records, and 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. S2 citations returned 314 window records covering 283 unique identities, but anonymous throttling and the traversal time window left parts uncollected; the author source also hit HTTP 429. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Retries of eight older fulltext blockers did not recover the required bodies. A multiplier-versus-percentage conflict between SMO’s official abstract and body is recorded without altering either source. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time review-status bulletin, not a new-paper edition or a claim that no later updates exist.
